com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.com

Interface IDataCommunicationElement

  • All Superinterfaces:
    ICommunicationElement, IHasModelObject, IModelAbstraction

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IDataCommunicationElement
extends ICommunicationElement
    IDataCommunicationElement represents a data element. It contains the full context information (component prototype, port prototype, data type hierarchy) suitable for e.g. data mapping.

    The data communication elements are hierarchically structured according to the data type (primitive, record/union or array).

    • Method Detail

      • getLeafsFullExpanded

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IDataCommunicationElement> getLeafsFullExpanded()
        Retrieves the leaf data communication elements for data mapping. These elements can be mapped to group signals further.
        See IComponentPort.getComElementsFullExpanded() for further information and examples.
        Returns:
        A collection with the leaf data communication elements.

      • getLeafsFullExpandedExceptPrimitiveArrays

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IDataCommunicationElement> getLeafsFullExpandedExceptPrimitiveArrays()
        Does the same as getLeafsFullExpanded(), but does not expand arrays with primitive array elements. Use this method if you want to map the whole array to one system signal instead of mapping each array element to an own system signal.
        See IComponentPort.getComElementsFullExpandedExceptPrimitiveArrays() for further information and examples.
        Returns:
        A collection with the leaf data communication elements.
